title: Invite and recovery links (no email)
description: Accounts are created and recovered through single-use links. An administrator creates a user (username, role, optional linked player) and gets an invite link to pass on; the recipient opens it, enrols a passkey (or sets a password if they cannot), and is signed in. The same mechanism recovers an account: 'Send recovery link' in the admin UI or `user reset` on the server produces a link that lets the user enrol a new sign-in method. Using a recovery link ends all existing sessions and, by choice on the confirmation screen, removes the old passkeys and password. Links are random, stored only as a hash, expire (default 48 hours for invites, 1 hour for recovery), work once, and can be revoked. This replaces the current admin 'reset password' action, which sets a password the administrator knows and leaves old sessions alive.

recommended_model.name: Fable 5.2
recommended_model.rationale: The recovery path is the weakest point of any passkey system and must be designed together with WI-128.

acceptance_criteria: Administrators never see or set another user's password; the old reset-password action is removed
Links are at least 128 bits of randomness, stored hashed, single-use, expiring and revocable, and are shown once at creation
Opening a link shows who it is for and what it will do before anything changes
Completing recovery ends every existing session for that user
The link page is not cacheable, is excluded from referrers (Referrer-Policy: no-referrer) and its token is never written to logs
Guessing at link URLs is throttled
Creating, revoking and using a link are recorded in the account audit log
`user reset` on the server (WI-127) prints a recovery link built from the public URL

files_to_create: migrations/0NN_account_links.up.sql / .down.sql (next free number; may be combined with the WI-128 migration)
notes: users.password_hash is NOT NULL today; passkey-only users need it nullable (SQLite table rebuild in the migration).
GetAllUsers currently passes password_hash to the template (service_users_sessions.go:23) - stop that here.

testing_requirements: Unit tests: expiry, reuse, revocation, session invalidation

context.user_story: As a club administrator, I want to invite a captain or rescue a locked-out one by sending them a link.
context.programme: Club-readiness programme (sprints 019-024). Agreed constraints: BHPLTA clubs only; each club self-hosts its own instance; the original author must have no access to any other club's instance (no seeded accounts, no shared or default secrets, no phone-home); passkeys are the default sign-in with passwords as an optional fallback; the captain role is real; SQLite is the only supported database; CourtHive is bundled as an opt-in part of the package so clubs can run their own club championships.
